narrative.northStar: A quiet view of your attention
narrative.overview: The native apps follow the supplied Opal hierarchy using Amythest branding: a black canvas, original animated amethyst geode, flat charcoal groups, white primary actions and restrained lavender state cues. Windows uses top Home, Apps, Timer and Settings destinations; Android uses bottom Home, Apps and Timer with Settings through the profile action. Chrome's existing Aero surface is outside this native redesign.

rules.name: Accent signals state
rules.body: Use lavender for selected navigation and progress; use white for headings and neutral gray for descriptions.

rules.name: Art has no frame
rules.body: Keep the geode silhouette complete on the black canvas and let stage transitions finish before captures.

dos: Preserve local tracking, secure account sync and Hard Mode behavior.
Review Windows default and minimum sizes and Android system insets.
donts: Do not restore Windows 7 captions, glossy buttons, bevels or Frutiger Aero gradients in native apps.
Do not fabricate wellness scores, focus achievements or time saved.
Do not apply the native redesign to Chrome without a separate request.
